corpus.description: adjudicated human/second-review defects at the exact heads the production reviewer also reviewed; every entry is a REAL defect, so any demotion of a corpus finding is by definition a wrong demotion

method.replay: the branch's own compiled code — deriveNegativeEvidenceRules -> serializeNegativeEvidenceArtifact -> negativeEvidenceRulesFromArtifact -> applyNegativeEvidence — driven over every corpus finding via an esbuild bundle of the worktree sources (scratch harness, not committed)
method.counterfactual: rules derived under an ASSUMED fully clean provider run at each finding's own head (the maximally dangerous derivation state); where the assumption matters it was checked empirically (see empirical_checks)
method.category_worst_case: the corpus carries no model category labels; each finding was probed against every declared category of the applicable rule, so a recorded demotion is an upper bound over category assignments

postures.N_narrow: per-language formatter/lint/schema trio; style-only categories (lint +docs, schema +other); max_severity minor; tool-natural paths
postures.B_broad: same trio; ALL parse-legal categories; max_severity major (the parse-time maximum); repo-wide paths (**)

method.verdict_policy: strict mapping forces request_changes only when an open finding is blocker or major (src/enforcement/verdict-policy.ts), so only a major->minor demotion can flip a verdict; blocker findings are never demoted (application hard cap) and a minor->info demotion cannot flip

excluded: tests-v3/acquisition-workspace (hang this sandbox's runner on clean main; excluded per eval constraints)
suite.failure_attribution: all 4 failures are in test files byte-identical to origin/main (verified by diff) and fail for macOS-sandbox reasons: /proc/self/cmdline absent (run-confidence #1073), /proc-based process-identity/zombie probing (executor-local, whose own skip note documents the Linux-only design), ENAMETOOLONG on a deliberately over-long tmp path (executor-local). Environmental, pre-existing, not branch regressions.

N_narrow.note: structurally zero on this corpus: all 74 corpus findings are major/blocker, and the minor ceiling makes majors severity-inadmissible (71 no-match) while the blocker cap records the one matched blocker (alert-triage#153) as a refusal

The diff removes the entire validate job: 215 pytest cases with coverage gate, smoke_test.sh, 31 bash test suites, py_compile checks, yamllint duplicate-key detection, and action.yml/example YAML validation. The replacement YAML validation (yaml.safe_load) does not catch duplicate keys — it silently keeps the last valu
wrong_demotions.class: lint identity gate on a finding ABOUT the tool
wrong_demotions.why: The real defect is 'the PR deletes the entire test suite under the guise of add-shellcheck-to-CI'; the human text names yamllint/shellcheck because the regression REMOVES their CI coverage. The lint gate reads that mention as a lint-violation claim. The model's finding would name the tool the same way. Provider empirically clean at the exact head (see empirical_checks[0]) — the rule derives.
wrong_demotions.flip: bot APPROVED at head; had the reviewer emitted this real major as its sole blocking finding, the strict mapping forces request_changes, and the demotion to minor re-approves — the exact sole-major masking shape.

wrong_demotions.reason: negative evidence: schema provider 'prisma-validate' ran clean at head 91bbc0fde1d0 covering 'prisma'; major demoted to minor
wrong_demotions.message_excerpt: Schema migration — Adding notes field to 3 models requires a Prisma migration. Ensure migration is planned/deployed with this change.
wrong_demotions.why: The real defect is a missing Prisma migration for a schema change — semantic. The phrase 'Schema migration' matches the schema claim regex on the word 'Schema'. prisma validate checks schema-file validity, which holds, so the provider runs clean while the real defect stands; no local prisma CLI in the sandbox, adjudicated from the defect text (the finding is about migration completeness, not schema validity).
wrong_demotions.flip: NO_BOT_REVIEW at head; masking exposure is the same shape had the defect been found (sole major).

wrong_demotions.reason: negative evidence: formatter provider 'gofmt' ran clean at head ff99fc4de2ad covering '**'; major demoted to minor
wrong_demotions.message_excerpt: ParseMCPStatus in internal/executor/mcp_status.go doesn't parse what OpenCode 1.18.31 actually prints, so in production it reports nothing useful. The tests pass because the fixtures are invented clean output. A healthy server parses to []. A failed server parses to a server named '|', with no reason, and github is missing... Each entry line starts with a bullet glyph and the status word carries a
wrong_demotions.why: The real defect is a parser that cannot read OpenCode's actual output (ANSI-prefixed status words, box-drawing continuation lines). The words 'whitespace' and 'indented' appear only as incidental vocabulary describing the protocol shape ('continuation lines start with a box-drawing character rather than whitespace, so the reason line isn't treated as indented'). The pure-formatting regex fires on them. A formatter run says nothing about parser semantics and would run clean; no Go toolchain in the sandbox, adjudicated from the defect text (the finding claims a semantic parse bug, not a formatting violation).
wrong_demotions.flip: bot APPROVED at head; same sole-major masking shape had the defect been found.

wrong_demotions.reason: negative evidence: schema provider 'kubeconform' ran clean at head 63a55be53f08 covering '**'; major demoted to minor
wrong_demotions.message_excerpt: Return the mult-doc break / revert the yaml server removal / revert removing the yaml anchor / $schema is missing, this happened previously as well / This didn't part properly and is no longer structured in a human readable format
wrong_demotions.class: schema cue on incidental vocabulary + provider blind spot
wrong_demotions.why: The real defect bundle ('$schema is missing', 'didn't part properly', multi-doc break, removed yaml anchor) is semantic/structural. The file at the exact head PARSES cleanly (empirical check below), so parse-level and CRD-skipping schema providers derive a rule, and the schema cue fires on the literal token '$schema'. A schema tool that skips CRDs (kubeconform's default for ExternalSecret) is clean on exactly the file that is broken.
wrong_demotions.flip: NO_BOT_REVIEW at head; masking exposure hypothetical (sole major).
wrong_demotions.empirical: yamllint exit 0 at head — file parses

identity_hole.description: the lint/schema claim gate passes when the message word-boundedly mentions the declared identity; the parser accepts ANY 1-128 char token as identity, including prose words
identity_hole.probe: lint rule over ** with all categories, identity set to a common word, tested against all 74 real corpus texts
identity_hole.note: no plausible operator declaration does this, but nothing refuses it — an operator misconfiguration silently voids the identity gate

defaults_hazard.where: src/evidence/providers.ts parseNegativeEvidenceSpec — omitted max_severity defaults to 'major', the dangerous end of the axis on this corpus (all 74 findings major/blocker)
defaults_hazard.why_it_matters: the narrow posture that scores zero wrong demotions requires the operator to explicitly declare max_severity: minor; a declaration that omits the field gets the unsafe ceiling by default

verdict_flip_accounting.why: the feature is inert without an operator declaration, and at every corpus head the production reviewer either never emitted the finding (59 APPROVED / 7 NO_BOT_REVIEW heads missed the defect) or flagged it without a demote-shaped claim (real-prose stress: 0 gate passes)
verdict_flip_accounting.counterfactual_note: 2 of the 4 genuine wrong demotions sit on PRs whose production review was APPROVED — had the reviewer emitted the real major as its sole blocking finding, the demotion would have re-approved (sole-major flip shape); the other 2 sit on NO_BOT_REVIEW heads

limitations: the corpus is one-sided by construction (adjudicated REAL defects only): it calibrates the wrong-demotion axis decisively, but cannot measure recall (how much genuine formatter/lint noise a broad enable would suppress) — no adjudicated noise corpus exists

all corpus severities are major/blocker: the categories axis is uncalibrated (nothing minor/info in the corpus), and category assignments in the replay are worst-case probes over declared categories, not model labels

the demotion replay substitutes the adjudicated human finding text for the model's finding message (the bot never emitted these findings); at the flag-same heads the bot's ACTUAL published prose was tested separately (0 gate passes in 130 chunks), but those reviews are v2-era long-form — v3-era terse finding messages are less sampled there

empirical cleanliness could be run only where a tool exists in the sandbox (yamllint): the go/prisma/actionlint candidates were adjudicated from the defect texts; gofmt-clean and prisma-validate-clean are plausible but not machine-verified

the assumed-clean counterfactual is the maximally dangerous derivation state; in production the derivation gate refuses exactly the runs where the tool would have caught the claimed defect (see llmkube-images#237), so live wrong-demotion exposure is bounded by the genuinely-clean cases measured here

recommendation.decision: DECLARE NARROWLY or NOT AT ALL — never broadly
conditions: if declared at all: max_severity must be explicitly 'minor' (the only posture with zero wrong demotions on this corpus); the omitted-field default of 'major' is the unsafe end

categories: style-only for formatters (style+docs for linters, style+other for schema tools); the corpus cannot vouch for bug/verification declarations (category axis uncalibrated, all 4 genuine wrong demotions needed a non-style category under worst-case assignment)
never declare an identity token that is a common prose word (identity gate voided: 'the' passes 71/74 real texts)
do not declare a provider over paths it does not actually validate (vacuously-clean evidence produced the llmkube-images#237 demotion under the incompetent broad posture)
broad declaration (all categories, major ceiling, ** paths) is REJECTED by this eval: 4 real adjudicated defects demoted against a target of zero, 2 of them on approved-PR masking shapes
pre_broadening_requirements: a findings-about-the-tool guard: the lint identity gate must not fire when the message describes removing/altering the tool's coverage (the pr-reviewer-action#467 shape)

cue-word hygiene: the formatter/schema cue regexes must not fire on incidental vocabulary ('whitespace'/'indented' describing a protocol, '$schema' as a missing key, 'Schema migration') — consider requiring the claim to assert a violation OF the tool's domain rather than merely mentioning its vocabulary
an adjudicated noise corpus (model findings adjudicated as formatter/lint/schema noise) to measure recall before any broad enable
re-run this replay against the same corpus after any parser change
